description_en: Updates the information of a cloud application, such as the description, application tags, and patch uploads. You can upload patch packages or hot update packages, and create hot update packages for Android cloud application markets. A cloud application supports up to 20 patch packages, and only one patch package can be in the uploading state at a time
description_zh:
更新一个云应用的信息，如更新描述信息、更新应用标签、上传Patch等。
支持上传补丁包/热更包、支持安卓云应用市场制作热更包，一个云应用最多可上传20个补丁包、一个云应用同时只允许一个Patch是上传中状态
name: UpdateCloudAppInfo

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud application, which corresponds to a unique application package
parameters.help_zh: 云应用ID，对应唯一的应用包
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the stable patch. This is the default patch ID used in customer business scenarios, such as session startup, when no patch ID is specified. This parameter is not supported when PkgType is set to android. Special value: origin: cancels the patch version and uses the initial version by default
parameters.help_zh:
稳定版PatchId。客户业务使用中(如会话启动)未指定PatchId情况，默认使用的PatchId。PkgType=android时不支持。
特殊取值说明：
输入值origin：表示取消patch版本，默认使用初始版本
parameters.name: stable_patch_id

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically configure the patch as the stable patch after a successful upload. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 上传成功后是否自动配置为稳定版Patch，默认false
fields.name: as_stable_patch

fields.help_en: The download URL of the patch package. By default, the format of the patch package is the same as that of the original cloud application package. You must specify either RenderingInstanceId or DownloadURL. DownloadURL takes precedence
fields.help_zh:
Patch包下载地址。
RenderingInstanceId/DownloadURL 必选其一，
DownloadURL优先级高
fields.name: download_url

fields.help_en: The MD5 hash of the patch package, which is used to verify integrity. This parameter is valid and required only when DownloadURL is not empty
fields.help_zh: patch包md5，用于检查完整性。仅DownloadURL非空时有效，DownloadURL非空时必选
fields.name: md5

fields.help_en: The name or description of the patch package, which is one of the unique identifiers under the AppId. Naming conventions: 1. The value cannot be origin or all. 2. The length must be 1 to 50 characters. 3. The value can contain lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.). 4. The first and last characters must be letters or digits
fields.help_zh:
Patch包名称或描述，AppId下唯一标记之一。
默认取值规范：
不能等于origin、all
长度1-50
小写字母、数字、下划线'_'、中划线'-'、点分段'.'
首、尾字符必须为字母或数字
fields.name: patch_name

fields.help_en:
The format of the installation package. By default, the format is the same as the suffix of the download file URL. This parameter is valid only when DownloadURL is not empty. Valid values:
tar.gz
tar
zip
rar
fields.help_zh:
安装包格式，默认是下载文件地址后缀。仅DownloadURL非空时有效，取值范围：
tar.gz
tar
zip
rar
fields.name: pkg_format

fields.help_en: The relative path of the post-command within the application package. This parameter is supported only for Windows applications
fields.help_zh: 后置命令在应用包内的相对路径，仅支持 win 类型应用
fields.name: post_command_path

fields.help_en: The timeout period for executing the post-command, in seconds. This parameter is supported only for Windows applications
fields.help_zh: 后置命令执行超时时间(秒)，仅支持 win 类型应用
fields.name: post_command_timeout_sec

fields.help_en: The instance ID used to create the patch package. This parameter is valid only for Android application marketplace scenarios where PkgType is set to andrpid_appmarket. You must specify either RenderingInstanceId or DownloadURL. DownloadURL takes precedence
fields.help_zh:
制作patch包依赖的实例ID。仅安卓应用市场（PkgType=andrpid_appmarket）场景有效。RenderingInstanceId/DownloadURL 必选其一，
DownloadURL优先级高
fields.name: rendering_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The information about the patch package to be uploaded. 1. This parameter is not supported when PkgType is set to android. 2. Only one patch package can be in the uploading state (non-final state) for the same AppId at a time
parameters.name: patch

parameters.help_en:
The tags of the cloud application. You can specify multiple tags to reset the cloud application tags. Valid values:
hot
game
app
To delete all tags, set the value to ["NULL"]
parameters.help_zh:
云应用标签，可多选，将重置云应用标签，
取值范围：
  a. hot
  b. game
  c. app
特殊情况：
  a. 删除所有标签：输入["NULL"]
parameters.name: pkg_labels

PatchId.description_en: The ID of the patch package
